messages:
maya: Heads-up: planning a staging deploy of runtime v2.3.1 at 16:00 PT (about 40m). Main changes: small kernel selector tweak, KV-cache key normalization, and observability updates — new per-model latency heatmap + span tag 'model_variant'. Also adjusting prod alert threshold for inference 5xx rate for canary validation (0.5% -> 0.3%). Need someone to own the deploy, smoke checks, and rollback readiness. :rocket:

alex: I can run the deploy if that helps. Can start at 16:05 PT and will hold a 30m watch window. Will push artifact tagged `runtime:v2.3.1` and run preflight checks.

sam_k: FYI - I've updated dashboards under `dashboards/inference/` (new panel: latency_by_model_variant heatmap). Left a note in the dashboard JSON about required span tag; will push a dashboard PR once runtime is in staging.

priya: I'll take smoke tests during the watch window. Quick checklist I'm planning to run: 1) synthetic chatgen x100 through canary route (`/v1/generate?route=canary`) 2) 95th/99th latency by model_variant 3) trace sampling for a few requests to verify `model_variant` span tag 4) run the error-rate query against the last 5m. I'll post results in this thread.

alex: deploy plan condensed: 1) ensure CI green (deploy-bot) 2) push `runtime:v2.3.1` to staging 3) run smoke-suite (priya) 4) promotion to dedicated canary if green. Rollback command is `rctl rollback runtime v2.3.0` and images are pinned in the release note.

maya: tagging @priya and @alex — please confirm rollback window length you want. Ops needs the window to be explicit for the rollback playbook.

priya: 30m watch window is fine. If any 5xx spike or latency p99 > 1200ms I'll request rollback. Also will check traces for missing span tags.

alex: ack. I'll also keep a temp route override ready to route canary to `runtime:v2.3.0` if needed.

eva: Quick note on the alert change — lowering the 5xx threshold for the canary validation is OK but let's not touch prod-wide alerts until we confirm behavior. I updated a local alert rule YAML for the canary scope:```yaml
alert_name: inference_5xx_rate_canary
scope: canary
threshold: 0.003 # 0.3%
window: 5m
severity: P2
notify: #eng-oncall, #eng-platform
action: auto-close-if-recovered: true
```
I'll open an alert PR and link it to the deploy.

taylor: On tracing: make sure the sampler for staging is increased to 25% for the next hour so priya can capture enough spans. I pushed a quick config to `infra/tracing/staging.toml`.

deploy-bot: CI status: all checks passed for commit `a1b2c3d` on branch `release/runtime-v2.3.1` — ready for deploy. :white_check_mark:

oncall-bot: Oncall rotation for the next 24h: `eva` (primary), `sam_k` (secondary). Pager rules unchanged.

priya: I'll post the smoke test results here as bullets. Plan to run 100 requests spread across model_variants A/B. If anything looks off I'll add sample traces and a screenshot of the dashboard panel.

alex: starting deploy at 16:05 PT. tagging this thread with `deploy:staging` and will update status here.

maya: thanks all. small reminder for dashboard owners: please avoid changing production alert namespaces in the same deploy. Keep the alert PR limited to canary scope only.

(priya) 16:18 PT: smoke results — 100 requests done. p95: 430ms, p99: 920ms, errors: 0. 10 sample traces attached to the dashboard trace list. model_variant tag present on spans. No rollout block from my side.

alex 16:36 PT: promoted to canary dedicated pool. Watching metrics now.

priya 16:50 PT: canary pass so far. p99 has a small bump to 1050ms for model_variant B but still within rollback threshold. No increase in 5xx.

eva 16:55 PT: I'll merge the alert PR to the canary namespace now that data looks stable.

alex 16:58 PT: monitor complete. No rollback required. I'll create the release note and tag the runtime image. If anyone sees regressions overnight please ping me directly. :slightly_smiling_face:

maya 17:05 PT: great work — closing the loop. Will follow up with a short post in #eng-releases with links to the dashboard diffs and trace samples.

sam_k 17:08 PT: noted — will add the heatmap panel to the product-facing dashboard tomorrow and add a short README about the `model_variant` span tag for the oncall runbook.
